app.name: Spooky Break Reminder
app.pitch: A candle counts down your work time. When it goes out, the haunting begins, and only a real break can end it.
page.status: Placeholder page. The full app is on its way.
calm.heading: The candle is lit
haunt.heading: The candle has gone out
live.calm: The candle is lit. Next break: {breakType}.
whisper.eye: Do the Eye Ritual. Look far away.
whisper.breathing: Do the Breathing Ritual. Breathe slowly.
whisper.stretch: Do the Stretch Ritual. Reach and stretch.
snooze.none: The ghost accepts no further bargains for this haunting.
pause.heading: Pause reminders
eye.instruction: Look at something at least 6 metres (20 feet) away. Any key or press restarts the countdown, except on the Abandon button.
breathing.instruction: Hold the target for 3 to 6 seconds, then let go. Six counted breaths complete the Ritual.
breathing.target: Press and hold, or hold Space
breathing.holding: Holding. Let go to count the breath.
breathing.hint.exhaleReminder: Breathe out fully before you hold again.
breathing.hint.holdTooShort: That hold was too short. Hold for 3 to 6 seconds.
breathing.hint.holdTooLong: That hold was too long. Hold for 3 to 6 seconds.
stretch.ready: Done with this stretch? Press the button below.
stretch.neckTilt.title: Neck tilt
stretch.neckTilt.text: Tilt one ear toward your shoulder and hold. Then tilt toward the other side.
stretch.shoulderRoll.title: Shoulder roll
stretch.shoulderRoll.text: Roll both shoulders slowly backward in circles.
stretch.wristFinger.title: Wrist and finger stretch
stretch.wristFinger.text: Extend one arm, gently pull the fingers back, then switch hands.
stretch.standingReach.title: Standing reach
stretch.standingReach.text: Stand up, reach both arms overhead and stretch tall.
nightmare.warning.title: Turn on Nightmare Mode?
nightmare.warning.body: Nightmare Mode adds a Jump Scare. At the highest Haunting level, a full-screen ghost appears suddenly and a scream plays. It can startle you or people near you. It appears at most once per Haunting.
nightmare.warning.note: Nightmare Mode stays off until you confirm. Cancel keeps it off.
sound.blocked: The browser blocked sound. The visuals keep running.
settings.heading: Settings
settings.away: Count time away from the desk as a break
settings.awayHint: Uses the Idle Detection API to notice when you are idle or the screen is locked. Off by default. Your browser asks for permission when you turn this on.
settings.awayUnsupported: Away detection requires Chrome or Edge on desktop, because only those browsers provide the Idle Detection API.
settings.range: Valid range: {min} to {max}, in steps of {step}.
settings.invalid: That value is not allowed. The previous value is kept. Valid range: {min} to {max}, in steps of {step}.
settings.nightmareHint: Adds a sudden full-screen ghost and a scream at the highest Haunting level. Off by default.
settings.nightmareUnavailable: The content warning for Nightmare Mode is not available yet, so it cannot be turned on here.
settings.demo: Demo mode (the schedule runs 60 times faster)
settings.demoHint: Reloads the page. Demo data is kept apart from your normal data.
settings.eraseHint: Deletes everything this app saved in this browser and restores the default settings.
settings.eraseConfirm: Erase all saved data and restore the default settings? This cannot be undone.
notice.instanceInactive.title: The Haunting runs in another tab
notice.instanceInactive.message: Only one tab runs the Haunting, so notifications and sounds do not repeat. Take over to run it in this tab instead.
notice.reset.title: Saved data was reset
notice.reset.message: The saved data could not be read, so the default settings are loaded and a new work period has started.
notice.notSaved.title: Changes will not be saved
notice.notSaved.message: Browser storage is unavailable or full. Your changes last only until this page is closed or reloaded.
notice.awayDenied.title: Away detection is off
notice.awayDenied.message: The idle-detection permission was not granted. To allow it, open this site's settings in your browser, set the idle-detection permission to Allow, then reload the page.
notice.welcomeBack.title: Welcome back
notice.welcomeBack.message: You were away for {minutes} min. That counted as a break.
notice.haunting.title: Break overdue
notice.haunting.body: {breakType} is due. Haunting level {level}, {minutes} min overdue.
notify.status.granted: Notifications are allowed for this site.
notify.status.default: The browser has not asked yet. Turning this on asks for permission.
notify.status.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site.
notify.status.unsupported: This browser has no Notifications API, so system notifications are unavailable.
notify.siteSettings: To allow notifications, open this site's settings in your browser, set Notifications to Allow, then reload the page.
onboarding.intro: A candle burns down while you work. When it goes out, a Haunting begins and grows until you take a break.
onboarding.escalation: Each escalation step (2 minutes by default) raises the level by one, up to level 5. Higher levels add fog, cracks and whispers.
onboarding.rituals: Three Rituals end it: the Eye Ritual, 20 seconds of looking far away, and the Breathing or Stretch Ritual for longer breaks.
onboarding.modes: Office-safe mode is the default: dim, quiet and slow. Nightmare Mode, off by default, adds sudden scares and a scream.
onboarding.privacy: All data stays in this browser.
onboarding.optional: Away detection and notifications are optional and off by default.
onboarding.demo: Demo mode: 60 times faster, reloads the page
settings.ghostUnsupported: The Ghost Window needs a desktop browser that supports Document Picture-in-Picture, such as Chrome, Edge or Firefox 151 or later.
